description: This file defines backbone modules for an object detection model, including a frozen batch normalization layer, backbone base class, specific ResNet backbone, and a joiner class for combining backbone outputs with position encodings. It also includes a function to build the backbone model based on provided arguments.

classes.name: FrozenBatchNorm2d
classes.description: A BatchNorm2d layer with fixed batch statistics and affine parameters.

classes.name: BackboneBase
classes.description: Base class for backbone networks, managing layer freezing and output extraction.

classes.name: Backbone
classes.description: ResNet backbone with frozen BatchNorm, configurable for different ResNet variants.

classes.name: Joiner
classes.description: Sequential module combining backbone and position embedding, producing outputs and positional encodings.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for FrozenBatchNorm2d, initializes buffers for weight, bias, running mean, and variance.

methods.name: _load_from_state_dict
methods.description: Loads state dict, removing 'num_batches_tracked' if present.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Applies fixed batch normalization to input tensor.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for BackboneBase, sets up layer freezing and output layers.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Processes input NestedTensor through backbone layers, returning a dict of NestedTensors.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for Backbone, initializes a ResNet model with optional dilation and frozen BatchNorm.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Processes NestedTensor through backbone and returns outputs with positional encodings.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for Joiner, combines backbone and position embedding modules.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Processes NestedTensor through backbone and position embedding, returning outputs and positional encodings.

methods.name: build_backbone
methods.description: Builds and returns a combined backbone and position encoding model based on input arguments.
